sources.summary: Architecture studio Ortega Diago has transformed part of a warehouse in San Sebastian, Spain, into a locker room and changing facility for more than 100 factory workers. The studio founded by Gonzalo Sánchez Ortega and Armando Diago was approached to design the changing rooms in a long, narrow space at one end of a factory. The post Ortega Diago creates Brutalist changing rooms for San Sebastian factory appeared first on Dezeen .
